about: Hermes' own installer that `hermes twin remote-create --install-hermes` may run on another computer (twin#70).
version: the Hermes release the installer installs; url: a versioned https address of that exact script;
sha256: the digest of those bytes, checked on the target before the script runs.
Empty means not pinned yet: --install-hermes then FAILs instead of running an unpinned script.
